name: rowready
description: A private-by-design spreadsheet cleanup workbench with React and NestJS.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rowready/shared && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @rowready/web" "npm run dev -w @rowready/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rowready/shared && npm run build -w @rowready/api && npm run build -w @rowready/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rowready/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rowready/api && npm run typecheck -w @rowready/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rowready/shared && npm run build -w @rowready/api && npm run test -w @rowready/shared && npm run test -w @rowready/api && npm run test -w @rowready/web
scripts.versions: npm ls react vite typescript tailwindcss @nestjs/core --all
